Give the optimal uniquely decodeable code (minimum expected number of symbols) for the probability distribution $p = (16/69, 15/69, 12/69, 10/69, 8/69, 8/69)$.

Options: 
A. [7, 8, 9, 73, 83, 93]
B. [7, 8, 9, 71, 81, 91]
C. [7, 8, 9, 710, 810, 910]
D. [7, 8, 9, 70, 80, 90]
E. [7, 8, 9, 700, 800, 900]

H. [7, 8, 9, 75, 85, 95]
I. [7, 8, 9, 72, 82, 92]
J. [7, 8, 9, 76, 86, 96]

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
